philosophy.title: 我们的烘焙哲学
philosophy.p1: 《麦日记》，是我们与面粉、水和酵母对话的日记。这里记录的并非冰冷的配方，而是每一次烘焙背后的灵感、情绪与故事。
philosophy.p2: 我坚信，最好的味道源于最纯粹的食材和最耐心的守候。在这里，我想与你分享这份源自手作的温暖，以及烘焙带给我的简单快乐。让我们一起，用双手创造生活中的美好点滴。

diary.quote: “今天午后，阳光正好。我尝试在面团里加入了昨天新买的桂花干，烤箱运作时，整个屋子都弥漫着秋天的香气。那一刻我明白，烘焙于我而言，更像是一场温柔的创作。”
diary.author: —— 麦日记，十一月三日

menu.bread_intro_title: 时间的馈赠：我们的酸种欧包
menu.bread_intro_p1: 我们相信，最好的风味源自最纯粹的食材与最耐心的守候。每一颗欧包，都始于我们亲手培育的天然酵母，经过超过18小时的低温长时间发酵，让麦香与风味物质得以缓慢、充分地孕育。
menu.bread_intro_p2: 这不仅赋予了面包深邃、微酸的独特风味，更让面包体变得湿润、柔软且易于消化。这是我们对传统的致敬，也是献给您的、来自时间的馈赠。
menu.cake_intro_p1: 每一款蛋糕都以柔软的口感、细腻的奶香和精致的装饰为核心，像一段被认真准备的甜蜜时刻。我们用新鲜奶油、优质原料与细致手法，让每一次分享都更有仪式感。
menu.cake_intro_p2: 无论是生日、庆祝还是日常小小惊喜，这里的蛋糕都希望把幸福和温柔一口一口地送到你手中。

detail.storage_bread:
• 常温密封：可保存 2-3 天。
• 切片密封冷冻：可保存 3-4 周。
（⚠️ 请勿直接冷藏，冷藏会加速水分流线与淀粉老化）。
detail.storage_cake: 需冷藏保存（2°C - 6°C）。建议 2 天内食用完毕，以享受最佳口感与奶香。
detail.reheat_bread:
1. 喷水：表面轻喷少量水雾。
2. 烤箱/空气炸锅：预热 180°C 烘烤 3-5 分钟。
3. 平底锅：中火无油干煎切片至两面复酥金黄即可。
detail.reheat_cake: 冷藏取出后，建议室温静置 10-15 分钟回温后再食用，乳酪慕斯口感将更加丝滑顺柔。

philosophy.title: Our Baking Philosophy
philosophy.p1: MaiRiji is our diary of conversation with flour, water, and yeast. It is not only about precise recipes, but also about the inspiration, emotion, and stories hidden behind every bake.
philosophy.p2: We believe the best flavor comes from honest ingredients and patient care. Here, we share the warmth of handmade baking and the quiet joy it brings to everyday life.

diary.quote: “On a quiet afternoon, sunlight filled the room as the oven warmed. The scent of dried osmanthus drifted through the kitchen, and I remembered why baking feels so gentle and alive.”
diary.author: —— MaiRiji, 3 November

menu.bread_intro_title: A gift of time: our sourdough
menu.bread_intro_p1: We believe the best flavors come from the purest ingredients and the most patient care. Each loaf begins with naturally cultivated starter and a long fermentation of over 18 hours, allowing aroma and character to develop slowly and fully.
menu.bread_intro_p2: This gives our bread its deep, gentle acidity and a soft, moist crumb. It is our tribute to tradition and a gift from time to your table.
menu.cake_intro_p1: Every cake is built around a soft texture, rich creaminess, and thoughtful decoration, turning each celebration into a memorable moment. We use fresh cream, quality ingredients, and careful craftsmanship to make every sharing feel special.
menu.cake_intro_p2: Whether it is a birthday, a celebration, or simply a small surprise, our cakes are made to bring joy and tenderness to your table.

guides.del_box1_desc: Our bakery is located in Tanjong Sepat. We offer local home delivery and self-pickup.

guides.care_bread_rt_desc: Keep sealed and away from light for 2-3 days.
guides.care_bread_fz_desc: Slice and freeze sealed for up to 3-4 weeks (⚠️ Do not refrigerate, as it dries out the bread).
guides.care_bread_rh_desc: Mist with water, preheat oven/air fryer to 180°C and toast for 3-5 minutes.
guides.care_cake_rf_desc: Keep refrigerated at 2°C - 6°C. Consume within 2 days for best flavor.
guides.care_cake_sg_desc: Rest at room temperature for 10-15 minutes after unchilling for a silkier texture.
guides.faq_q1: ⏱️ 1. Why order at least 1 day in advance?
guides.faq_a1: Our sourdough undergoes a slow fermentation of over 18 hours. We bake to order and cannot accept instant same-day orders, so please order ahead.
guides.faq_a2: After selecting items and submitting details, you will be redirected to WhatsApp with your order summary. We will confirm exact schedule and timing with you.

detail.storage_bread:
• Room Temperature: Keep sealed for 2-3 days.
• Freezer: Slice and freeze sealed for up to 4 weeks.
(Avoid refrigeration as it dries out the bread).
detail.storage_cake: Keep refrigerated (2°C - 6°C). Consume within 2 days for optimal freshness and texture.
detail.reheat_bread:
1. Mist: Lightly spray water on the bread surface.
2. Oven/Air Fryer: Preheat to 180°C and bake for 3-5 minutes.
3. Pan Fry: Toast sliced bread in a dry pan on medium heat until crispy.
detail.reheat_cake: Take out from fridge and let it rest at room temperature for 10-15 minutes before serving for a softer, silkier texture.
